recipes.name: Berry Spinach Protein Smoothie Packs
recipes.steps:
1. Fill 5 freezer bags, each with 1 sliced banana, 1/2 cup blueberries, 1 cup spinach, 1 scoop protein and 1 Tbsp flax.
2. Freeze flat.
3. To serve: empty a pack into the blender with 1 cup soy milk and blend 60 seconds.
recipes.notes: The packs live in the freezer, so they're good any day of the week.

recipes.name: Black Bean, Sweet Potato & TVP Chili
recipes.steps:
1. Heat oil; cook onion and peppers 5 min. Add garlic, chili powder, cumin and cocoa; cook 1 min.
2. Add tomatoes, broth, sweet potato, quinoa, TVP, beans and 2 cups water.
3. Simmer 30 min, partly covered, until sweet potato is tender and quinoa is cooked. Add water if it gets too thick.
4. Season with salt. Cool, portion into 6 containers. Freezes for 3+ months.
recipes.seed_key: Black Bean, Sweet Potato & TVP Chili

recipes.name: Blueberry Protein Overnight Oats
recipes.steps:
1. In a big bowl, whisk soy milk, protein powder and maple syrup until smooth.
2. Stir in oats, chia, flax and hemp.
3. Divide into 5 jars. Top each with 1/2 cup blueberries and 1 Tbsp peanut butter.
4. Refrigerate at least 6 hours. Eat cold or microwave 1-2 min.
5. Keeps 4 days in the fridge - texture suffers if frozen, so the planner keeps these early in the week.

recipes.name: Brazil Nuts (selenium)
recipes.steps: 1 serving = 2 Brazil nuts. Don't eat more than ~4 a day (selenium becomes too much).

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit (banana + berries)
recipes.steps: No prep - keep bananas on the counter and berries in the freezer. Easy carbs and potassium.

recipes.name: Glass of Fortified Soy Milk
recipes.steps: 1 cup. Shake the carton well - the added calcium settles to the bottom.

recipes.name: Lemony Lentil Quinoa Power Salad
recipes.steps:
1. Cook quinoa (1.25 cups + 2.5 cups water, 15 min), cool.
2. Massage kale with 1 tsp of the oil and a pinch of salt for 1 minute (keeps it tender for days).
3. Whisk tahini, lemon juice, remaining oil, garlic, salt and 2-3 Tbsp water.
4. Toss everything except pumpkin seeds; portion into 5 containers and top with seeds.
5. Fridge 4 days. Doesn't freeze.

recipes.name: PB Chocolate Protein Energy Bites
recipes.steps:
1. Pulse dates in a food processor until a paste forms.
2. Add everything else and pulse until it holds together when pressed (add soy milk 1 Tbsp at a time if dry).
3. Roll into 24 balls (1 serving = 3 bites). Fridge 1 week or freeze 3 months.

recipes.name: Peanut Soba Noodles with Tempeh
recipes.steps:
1. Steam tempeh slices 10 min (removes bitterness), then pan-sear with 1 Tbsp of the soy sauce until browned.
2. Cook soba per package, rinse under cold water, drain well.
3. Whisk peanut butter, remaining soy sauce, lemon juice, maple, ginger, garlic and 4-6 Tbsp warm water.
4. Toss noodles, vegetables and edamame with sauce; top with tempeh and sesame seeds. Portion into 5 containers.
5. Eat cold or room temp. Best within 4 days - soba doesn't freeze well.

recipes.name: Pumpkin & Hemp Seed Topper
recipes.steps: Mix and store in a jar. 1 serving = 3 Tbsp - sprinkle on bowls, oats or salads. Zinc, iron, magnesium.

recipes.name: Red Lentil, Chickpea & Tofu Coconut Curry
recipes.steps:
1. Start the rice: 2 cups brown rice + 4 cups water, simmer covered 40-45 min.
2. Meanwhile, sauté onion 5 min in a splash of broth. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder and cumin; cook 1 min.
3. Add lentils, tomatoes, broth and coconut milk. Simmer 20 min until lentils are soft.
4. Add chickpeas and tofu; simmer 5 min. Stir in spinach, lemon juice and salt.
5. Portion curry and rice into 6 containers. Freezes very well (up to 3 months).
recipes.seed_key: Red Lentil, Chickpea & Tofu Coconut Curry

recipes.name: Roasted Garlic Broccoli & Sweet Potatoes
recipes.steps:
1. Toss sweet potatoes with half the oil and salt; roast at 425°F for 15 min.
2. Add broccoli, garlic and remaining oil; roast 15 more minutes.
3. Squeeze lemon over, cool, portion. Fridge 4 days.

recipes.name: Simple Brown Rice
recipes.steps:
1. Rinse rice. Bring 2 cups rice + 4 cups water + salt to a boil.
2. Cover, simmer on low 40-45 min, then rest 10 min covered.
3. Cool quickly (spread on a tray), portion into 6 containers (~2/3 cup cooked each). Freezes well.

recipes.name: Tempeh Bolognese with Whole-Wheat Pasta
recipes.steps:
1. Heat oil; cook onion, carrot and mushrooms 8 min. Add crumbled tempeh and soy sauce; brown 5 min.
2. Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 1 min. Add crushed tomatoes, red lentils and 1.5 cups water.
3. Simmer 20 min, stirring, until lentils melt into the sauce. Stir in nutritional yeast and salt.
4. Cook pasta 1 min short of al dente (it softens on reheating). Toss with a little sauce so it doesn't clump.
5. Portion pasta + sauce into 6 containers. Freezes well; add a splash of water when reheating.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Tofu & Edamame Rice Bowls
recipes.steps:
1. Cook rice (1.75 cups rice + 3.5 cups water, ~45 min).
2. Toss tofu with the oil and 1 Tbsp cornstarch; bake at 425°F for 25 min, flipping once.
3. Roast broccoli and carrots on a second tray for the last 15 min.
4. Sauce: whisk soy sauce, maple, garlic, ginger, the other 1 Tbsp cornstarch and 1/3 cup water; simmer 2 min until glossy.
5. Toss tofu in sauce. Build 5 bowls: rice, tofu, broccoli, carrots, 1/2 cup edamame, sesame seeds.
6. Fridge 4 days, or freeze (broccoli softens a little).

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Burritos
recipes.steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet. Cook onion and pepper 5 min until soft.
2. Add crumbled tofu, cumin, chili powder, salt and nutritional yeast. Cook 8 min, stirring, until lightly golden.
3. Stir in black beans and spinach until the spinach wilts. Let the filling cool completely (prevents soggy burritos).
4. Divide onto tortillas, add 1 Tbsp salsa each, roll tightly and wrap each in foil or parchment.
5. Fridge: up to 4 days. Freezer: up to 3 months.
6. Reheat: from fridge, microwave 1.5-2 min or skillet; from frozen, microwave 3-4 min (unwrapped, in a damp paper towel), flipping halfway.
